data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 11.629 million for the 2015 and prior years of account, primarily due to favourable settlements in 2018. This release represents a 4.43% reduction of the opening gross claims outstanding. Significant net releases were observed across various lines of business for accident years up to 2017, including Accident & Health, Fire & other damage to property, Third party liability, Property Reinsurance, and Liability Reinsurance. The 2016 and 2017 accounts were impacted by the 2017 Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria (HIM), with net incurred losses of $4.9 million and $6.5 million respectively. The 2018 year of account also saw impacts from Hurricane Florence and Michael, California wildfires, and an active typhoon season in Asia, though these were noted to have less meaningful impact due to diminished reinsurance catastrophe account.
